title: Hazelnut Algerian Green-Curry-Paste Tagine
description: A sweet and savory Algerian dish featuring green-curry-paste, tender chicken, and crunchy hazelnuts. This dish is perfect for a romantic dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Heat the binchotan charcoal in a charcoal grill or grill pan to 400F.
Season the chicken breast with salt, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the tagine and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the tagine and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the green curry paste to the tagine and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the tagine and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the tagine and simmer until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and continue to simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped hazelnuts and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice, garnished with additional hazelnuts if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
